# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_MEAN_REVERT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to VWAP after an extended deviation when the EMA ribbon is bullish and RSI shows oversold conditions. This mean-reversion edge is captured by going long on significant VWAP deviations filtered by ribbon alignment, RSI<40, and above-average volume.

## Mechanism

Enter long when: price < VWAP - 1.5×ATR(14), 5‑EMA > 8‑EMA > 13‑EMA (bullish ribbon), RSI(14) < 40, and bar volume > 1.2×20‑bar average volume. Exit: stop at prior swing low (structure invalidation) or if price re‑crosses VWAP; target at 1.5R or at VWAP (mean‑reversion). Regime filter: only trade after first 30 min of session and when VIX < 15 to avoid trending/news periods.
